QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_73

answer.text: Across both pre-commitment and post-commitment phases, from initial engagement through drawdowns, reporting, exits and follow-on funds

explanation.text: The Logic: The XIX-A workbook splits distributor services into two phases. Pre-commitment services begin with engagement with investment managers and investors, pitch preparation, due diligence and paperwork. Post-commitment services cover drawdowns, reporting, fund performance updates, exits, grievances and follow-on funds. The Trap: Limiting distribution to subscription signing, first drawdown or the annual meeting ignores the ongoing post-commitment activities the workbook lists. Note: The supported framing is the pre-commitment / post-commitment service set described on pages 270-271 of XIX-A.
